trainer_contract.architecture: Standalone invertible data-to-standard-normal flow; learned diagonal affine transform followed by flow_layers transforms. No VAE.
trainer_contract.preprocessing: Select 2..128 genes using training-only dispersion ranking. Deterministic per-cell uniform dequantization, log(count+U), then training-only mean/std. No library normalization. latent_dim equals selected_features.
trainer_contract.training: Exact change-of-variables density of standardized continuous coordinates; Adam betas (0.9,0.999), gradient clip 10. Validation NLL selects best checkpoint and patience. This is not an integer count likelihood or ELBO.
trainer_contract.generation: Normal latent, reverse transforms; planar uses 64-step monotone bisection and checks inverse residual, radial and affine coupling use analytic inverses. Undo training standardization; save continuous log-expression samples without rounding or exponentiation.
trainer_contract.tasks: Unconditional data_generation only. Coupling hidden_dim sets MLP width; planar/radial hidden_dim=16 is an unused schema placeholder.

evaluation.domain: Continuous log(count + fixed per-cell Uniform[1e-6,1) jitter), on a training-selected gene panel. Not raw integer counts or normalized expression.
evaluation.fidelity: Training-standardized mean marginal Wasserstein distance and correlation MAE on up to 64 training-variable genes; compare equal-size independently dequantized real references using existing 1.1x heuristic.
evaluation.diversity_overlap: Same distance-ratio and training-reference overlap diagnostics in standardized continuous log-expression coordinates. No exact-zero/count-validity claims.
evaluation.utility: No supervised utility for this unconditional generation objective. No biological or privacy guarantee.

trainer_contract.limits: Planar/radial limited expressiveness; low-dimensional selected panel only. Dequantization changes the target and removes exact zeros. Inverse failures/nonfinite outputs fail the run.

limitations: Samples are continuous log-dequantized selected-gene expression, not integer counts.
NLL is in standardized coordinates, not a discrete count likelihood or ELBO.
Planar/radial expressiveness is limited; no biological/downstream benefit is established.
